content: Your presentation on Friday was genuinely the best one. You should do more of those.
Honest question: where do you find all your music? Your playlists are elite.
I've wanted to say thanks for helping me move last spring. It meant a lot.
You talk over people in meetings sometimes. Small thing, but worth knowing.
What book should I read next? You always have good picks.
The way you handled that argument at dinner was really kind.
